recipe.visualDefinition: A dual portrait featuring a man in the foreground and a woman in the background, characterized by warm, high-contrast studio lighting and 1960s-era styling. The composition is anchored by a centered, swash-heavy display typeface at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Foreground male figure in sharp focus vs. background female figure in soft focus
Warm skin tones against a deep, dark, textured background
Ornate, decorative typography integrated into the upper third of the frame
Hand placement on the shoulder creating a diagonal connection between subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The male subject is large and centered in the lower-right foreground; the female subject is slightly smaller, positioned behind his right shoulder in the upper-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The male subject's direct gaze and the large, stylized name at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold typography, moves down to the male subject's face, follows the hand on the shoulder up to the female subject's face.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black/dark brown space surrounding the subjects, concentrated in the upper corners and bottom edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and black (background and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and peach (skin tones and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast between the lit faces and the dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme swashes on capital letters (W, N, T)
Variable stroke width with high contrast
Italicized subtitle text with cursive-like flow
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended tails on 'W' and 'N' that cradle surrounding letters
Interlocking swashes between adjacent capital letters

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed over the dark background space above the subjects
Floats over the hair of the subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate display serif paired with a lighter, slanted calligraphic serif for contrast in weight and formality.
graphicDevices: Corner metadata text in small sans-serif
Circular logo in bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 60s/70s decorative serif aesthetic with extended tails.
Provides the necessary calligraphic feel for the subtitle text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a young man with styled 1960s hair in the foreground looking at the camera, and a blonde woman in soft focus behind him looking down. Warm amber lighting, dark textured background, 35mm film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large centered name in a cream-colored decorative swash serif at the top. Below it, add a subtitle in a smaller, golden-tan italic serif.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting warm and reminiscent of 1960s studio photography?
Do the capital letters in the main title have decorative swashes?
Is there a clear depth of field between the two subjects?

adjustableVariables: Focus fall-off between foreground and background subjects
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast shadows on the faces.
Ensure the typography color is off-white or warm tan, not pure white.
Verify the background is dark and relatively featureless to make subjects pop.
Confirm the hair styles reflect the mid-20th century era.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a warm-toned double portrait with shallow depth of field and top-heavy, swash-serif display typography to evoke a mid-century nostalgic mood.
